evals.name: discover-and-profile-with-research
evals.prompt: falで最近出たtext-to-imageモデルを探して、手頃な価格のものを1つ選んでプロファイル化して。用途はブログのアイキャッチ画像(16:9)。そのモデルの推奨プロンプトの書き方も公式ドキュメントで調べてテンプレートにまとめておいて。最後にテストで1枚だけ生成して。
evals.expected_output: A newest-first shortlist, a chosen model with price, a profile with 16:9 defaults pinned, a researched prompting.md with templates and cited sources, and one generated image saved with a manifest.
assertions: Presented a shortlist of recent text-to-image models ordered newest-first (with dates)
Chose a model and stated its unit price
Saved a reusable model config pinned to 16:9 (landscape_16_9 or aspect_ratio 16:9)
prompting.md contains a ```template block for the blog-header use case with {slot} placeholders, and its fixed wording applies the model's documented prompt structure (not just '{subject}, {style}')
prompting.md cites at least 2 source URLs, at least one official (fal.ai or model vendor)
`fal profile check` passes and the profile is marked researched
Generated exactly one test image with `fal run --template` (manifest.prompt_template is set) and saved it locally
Looked at the test image and recorded it as the validation run (validated_with) or explained what to fix
fal API key never appears in any output file

evals.name: pipeline-image-to-video-confirm-first
evals.prompt: fal-ai/flux/schnell で「朝焼けの富士山、浮世絵風」の画像を2枚作って、1枚目を fal-ai/kling-video/v2.1/standard/image-to-video で5秒の動画にしたい。動画のほうは高いので、実行前に費用を見せて確認を取って。
evals.expected_output: Two images generated and saved; the video step prepared with the first image wired in, its cost estimated (~$0.28) and presented for approval instead of being submitted.
assertions: Generated two images with flux/schnell and saved both locally
Created or reused a profile for the video model and researched its input guide before preparing the video step (prompting.md has an Inputs section for image_url)
Did NOT submit the image-to-video job (no video file, no kling request)
Showed the video model's unit price with its unit (per second) and what a 5 s clip implies (about $0.25–$0.35)
Prepared the video step with the first image wired as image_url and a prompt rendered from a template (--dry-run output or the exact command)
Final message asks the user for approval before running the video

evals.name: export-standalone-skill
evals.prompt: fal-ai/flux/schnell をチームで使えるように、単体で動く skill にして ./.claude/skills に置いて。デフォルトは正方形・PNGで。
evals.expected_output: A self-contained skill directory under ./.claude/skills with valid SKILL.md frontmatter, bundled profile with square_hd/png defaults, and a runnable script (verified with a dry run).
assertions: Researched the model's input guide before exporting (prompting.md passes `fal profile check`)
Created a skill directory under ./.claude/skills with SKILL.md
SKILL.md frontmatter is valid (name matches dir, lowercase-hyphen, description <=1024 chars)
The description was written for the team's use (passed with --description), not only the generic category sentence
Defaults set to square and PNG in the skill's config
SKILL.md lists the profile's templates and tells the agent to run with --template
Skill is self-contained (no references to paths outside its own directory)
Skill was verified to run (dry-run or a real generation)

evals.name: choose-model-from-requirements
evals.prompt: falで、開始フレームと終了フレームの画像を指定できて、1080pで5秒くらいの動画を作れるモデルを探して。商用利用するので、ライセンスも確認したい。1本0.6ドル以内が希望。まだ生成はしないで、候補を比較して見せて。
evals.expected_output: A requirement-driven shortlist: candidates from recommend_model (when the fal MCP server is connected) and/or a newest-first catalog search, each finalist's schema checked for an end-frame input, 1080p and ~5 s duration, with prices (unit stated), licence noted, models that fail a hard requirement dropped, no quality claims without evidence, and no generation.
assertions: Collected candidates from the model catalog (fal models search) and/or the fal MCP server's recommend_model/search_models
Checked each finalist's input schema (fal schema or get_model_schema) rather than guessing parameters
Every model in the final shortlist accepts both a start image and an end image input (field names cited)
Every model in the final shortlist supports 1080p and a duration of about 5 s according to its schema
Stated a price with its unit for each finalist and compared it against the $0.60 budget
Mentioned the licence (or that it is unknown) for each finalist
Did not claim one model is highest quality without evidence; offered a side-by-side test instead
Did not submit any generation request (no fal run without --dry-run, no MCP run_model/submit_job)

evals.name: sprite-sheet-workflow
evals.prompt: RPGのアイテムアイコンを6個（剣、盾、ポーション、鍵、宝箱、巻物）、同じ画風のピクセルアートで作って、1つずつ背景透過のPNGにして。あとで同じ手順を何度も使いたいので、再利用できるskillにもしておいて。
evals.expected_output: The sprite-sheet workflow used end to end: profiles created for the sheet and cutout models, one sheet with 6 separated items generated and checked, background removed, split into 6 transparent PNGs with --expect 6 and recorded with fal ingest, then the workflow exported as a standalone skill that passes its own `workflow plan`.
assertions: Asked for or inferred the direction (assets, style, size per asset, repeat use) before building
Used a workflow (fal workflow init --example sprite-sheet or equivalent workflow.json) rather than ad-hoc one-off commands only
Workflow steps reference profiles, not raw endpoint ids, and the sheet step names a template
The sheet prompt was rendered from the template with the six items in item_list (manifest.prompt_template.slots)
Generated a single sheet containing all 6 items, and inspected it before running background removal
Either confirmed the sheet came back transparent and skipped the optional cutout, or ran background removal with the sheet wired in (--from label:…)
Produced exactly 6 separate PNG files with transparent backgrounds
Recorded the split pieces with fal ingest so they have a manifest
Exported a standalone skill directory containing SKILL.md, workflow.json, bundled researched profiles (gpt-image, remove-bg) and the split script
fal API key never appears in any output file

Said that each model step will use a researched profile and a named template, and which profiles need research
Mentioned the unit prices of the video step and what ~10 clips a week implies
